change.name: knowledge_worker_ingestion_writes
preconditions: SELECT to_regclass('knowledge.dataset_process_rules') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('knowledge.document_pipeline_executions') IS NOT NULL
postconditions: SELECT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','SELECT') AND has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','INSERT') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','UPDATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','DELETE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','TRUNCATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','REFERENCES') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.dataset_process_rules','TRIGGER')

SELECT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','SELECT') AND has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','INSERT') AND has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','UPDATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','DELETE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','TRUNCATE') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','REFERENCES') AND NOT has_table_privilege(left(current_user,length(current_user)-5)||'knowledge_worker','knowledge.document_pipeline_executions','TRIGGER')
change.notes: Candidate021 grants only the Knowledge worker INSERT on immutable dataset_process_rules and UPDATE on document_pipeline_executions, required by the normal prepare_execution and complete_execution ingestion path. Root review and isolated own-role rollback probe are required before activation.
